notes.title: Intruders release!
notes.notes:
Intruders are finally out now with a 20% discount!

If you encountered any bugs, just start a new discussion on the community page. I will try to fix them as fast as possible. If you didn't like something I would love to hear your opinion, so I can try and change things you didn't like or you think should work differently.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2513130/discussions/


Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Release Date!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I want to announce that I will release Intruders on October 26! This is my first game that I've made. At the start, it was a very small project and I didn't know that it would see some future, because after I finished my courses I just wanted to test my skills and after playing around for a bit I managed to implement more and more stuff that I planned. I saw some potential in that game, so I decided to try and fully finish this project, though I am very limited with budget and time because I'm just 18 years old student.

I am looking forward to any criticism about the game. Your feedback is very important to me as it helps to understand what I can improve. My second project will probably take much more time to make as I want to improve everything I've already learned. 

Thanks to everyone, will see you on release :)
